signupClosedScreen.title: Signups are currently closed

providerCallbackPage.signupClosedSubtitle: Sorry, Cadet is not accepting new signups at this time. Feel free to try again later.
providerCallbackPage.failedSubtitle: Something went wrong during social sign-in. Please try again or use a different method.
providerCallbackPage.completingSubtitle: Please wait while we finish authenticating you.

providerSignupPage.completingSubtitle: Please wait while we load your information.
providerSignupPage.completeAccountSubtitle: We need a few more details to finish setting up your account.

authErrors.genericFailure: Something went wrong. Please try again.
authErrors.signupClosed: Sorry, Cadet is not accepting new signups at this time. Feel free to try again later.
authErrors.providerSignup: No Cadet account is linked to that login yet. Sign up first, then sign in.
authErrors.loginIncomplete: Your account needs another step to finish signing in. Please sign in on the web, then try again.
authErrors.desktopUpdateRequired: This version of the Cadet desktop app can't sign in. Update the app, then try again.
authErrors.loopbackStateMismatch: Login failed: state mismatch. Please try again.

welcome.title: Welcome to Cadet
welcome.body: Your own personal intelligence is just a step away.

appShell.errorBody: It didn't respond just now. If your assistant was just started, give it a moment, then retry.
appShell.notReadyBody: It isn't up right now. Try again in a bit, or start it from your Cadet account.
appShell.wakeFailed: The wake didn't go through just now. Try again in a bit.
appShell.title: Assistant

addRemoteOriginDialog.title: Add a Remote Assistant
addRemoteOriginDialog.body: Paste the https link your assistant’s pairing page gave you.
addRemoteOriginDialog.addFailed: Failed to add the assistant. Please try again.

connectAssistantDialog.title: Connect a Remote Assistant
connectAssistantDialog.instruction: Paste the pairing link from the assistant's Pair a device settings, or just its address, and approve the request there.
connectAssistantDialog.linkGuidance: This link came from a pairing QR code. To connect this device, paste the pairing link from the assistant's machine here.
connectAssistantDialog.legacyLinkGuidance: This link came from an older version of the app and can no longer be used. Generate a new pairing link on the assistant's machine and paste it here.
connectAssistantDialog.approveOnHost: Approve this code on the assistant's machine to finish connecting.
connectAssistantDialog.retrying: The assistant isn't ready to pair yet. Still trying until the code expires.
connectAssistantDialog.retryExpired: The pairing code expired before the assistant was ready to pair. Start over to get a new one.
connectAssistantDialog.submitError: Failed to connect to that assistant. Please try again.
connectAssistantDialog.importedBody: This pairing is access-only: it works now, but its access expires and cannot renew itself. When it does, generate a fresh pairing link on the assistant's machine and paste it here to pair again.

connectRecoveryDialog.repairBody: Repairing re-provisions this assistant’s authentication token. Any other devices or browser sessions connected to it will be signed out and need to reconnect.
connectRecoveryDialog.authFailedBody: The authentication token for {name} is missing or can no longer be refreshed, so this assistant can’t be connected. You can repair it, retire it, or pick a different assistant.
connectRecoveryDialog.retireFailed: Failed to retire the assistant. Please try again.

hostingScreen.title: Hosting
hostingScreen.body: Choose where you want your assistant to live.

apiKeyScreen.title: Connect a Model Provider
apiKeyScreen.body: Choose the model provider your assistant should use.
apiKeyScreen.modelsHelp: Comma-separated model identifiers exposed by your endpoint.

hatchingScreen.wakingBody: Hang tight, your assistant will have a few questions for you once it's up.
